Name: Shane's Room Redesigned (for Content Patcher)
Author: SylverScourge
Description:
Does exactly what the overview says. Replaced the trash with furniture and mops up his mess because I refuse to get mud on my floors smh. This is my first mod so it may be a bit hard to navigate if he's hanging out at the fridge.

Just put it into your mods folder and try not to touch anything because if you change any files I can't help you.

Downloads.Description: Unzip the file and drop it into your mods. Made a fix so you can walk between the chair and sofa to make it more compatible with multiple spouses.
